name: aircooled_chiller_refsim
title: Air-cooled water chiller, reference simulation model
summary: Reference simulation model of an air-cooled water chiller of the ULiège model bank: a scroll compressor described in four steps (suction heating-up, isentropic compression, isochoric compression, discharge cooling-down) with all its heat transfers represented by a fictitious wall of uniform temperature, an air-cooled condenser whose fan is controlled on the condensing temperature, and a water-supplied evaporator, both heat exchangers being described by three thermal resistances in series referred to their nominal flows.

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), air-cooled water chiller reference simulation model, 4 January 2008; IEA A43 PR2 A15 reference model (printed documentation of the same model: 'IEA A43 PR2 A15 Reference air-water chiller EES model VTJL PhAJL080108.pdf' in the same folder)

verification.reference: Solution printed by EES in the equations window of the source file ('Example of solution: Variables in Main', 117 variables); the Variable Information records of the file are cleared (-9999: the model was last prepared, not run), so no stored solution is available
verification.notes: 116 common variables, 11 differ above rtol=0.001, maximum relative difference 6.16e-03 (C_dot_su_cp: 89.63 against 89.0779 W/K). The 11 differences all belong to the compressor heat-transfer block (c_p_su_cp 5.97e-03, NTU_su_cp 6.05e-03, Q_dot_su_cp 3.28e-03, t_su1_cp 2.57e-03, epsilon_su_cp 2.29e-03, Q_dot_ex_cp 2.62e-03, w_in2_cp 2.60e-03, NTU_ex_cp 1.12e-03, Q_dot_amb_cp 1.16e-03) or to the evaporating temperature (1.02e-03): they follow from the specific heat of R22 at the suction, 0.6 % apart between EES 7.793 and CoolProp. All the results of the cycle (powers, flows, COP, water and refrigerant temperatures, conductances, effectivenesses) agree to better than 1e-3, the printed EES values being rounded to 4 significant digits. No variable excluded from the comparison; the 17 variables only in the CoolSolve solution are the state points of the diagrams added for the GUI and the string variable fluid$.
